name: hierarchical_agent_files_init
title: Hierarchical Agent File Scaffold
description: Scaffold a two-level parent + children agent-file hierarchy in one shot. Delegates per-node base scaffolding to agent_files_init (from the agent-files skill) and patches each node with hierarchy-specific clauses: a slim child AGENT.md (parent-first read order, precedence, update routing back to parent, boundary), a parent-outer-boundary constraint in each child AGENT_GOAL.md, the progress-scope rule in the parent AGENT_HARNESS.md, and a seeded parent AGENT_PROGRESS.md Completed Changes ledger.

parent_dir.description: Directory where the parent four-file agent contract is scaffolded.

parent_mission.description: Long-term mission written into the parent AGENT_GOAL.md. Required so the scaffolded contract is internally consistent on first read.

parent_objective.description: Optional in-flight objective for the parent AGENT_PROGRESS.md. If omitted, the Current Objective section is removed by agent-files rather than left as a placeholder.

parent_name.description: Short name used in child cross-references (e.g., in the child precedence block). Defaults to basename(parent_dir) with trailing slash stripped.

children.description: List of direct-child nested workspaces to scaffold under parent_dir.

relative_dir.description: Child folder name relative to parent_dir. Must be a single path segment: no slashes, no '..', not absolute.

mission.description: Long-term mission written into this child's AGENT_GOAL.md.

objective.description: Optional in-flight objective for this child's AGENT_PROGRESS.md.

overwrite.description: If true, existing files in any node are replaced. If false, a pre-existing parent contract causes an abort; a pre-existing child contract causes files_skipped with patches still applied.

children_created.description: Absolute paths of child directories successfully scaffolded.

files_created.description: Per-node files created. Keyed by node absolute path; value is list of files written.

files_skipped.description: Per-node files skipped because they already existed and overwrite was false.

patches_applied.description: Per-node patch names applied after the base files were placed. Expected parent patches: ['progress_scope_rule', 'parent_progress_seed']. Expected child patches: ['child_agent_md', 'child_outer_boundary'].

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues: progress-scope rule already present, child AGENT_GOAL.md missing ## Constraints, child directory already had a contract (files skipped, patches still applied).
